Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes the quantity of items already in the cart, or removes an item. Specify only the items you want to change; the rest stay as they are. A quantity of 0 removes that item. Identify items by the item.id from a get_cart result.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. Without them the other items in the cart are ordered too. Domestic and international shipping items cannot be checked out together; if the cart has both, ask the user which group to check out and pass that group's item_ids. To buy one product immediately without using the cart, use create-checkout-url. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

sites.name: andongwavely.com
sites.description: Online store with product search, cart management and checkout tools.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Searches products in this store. In addition to a product name you can pass situational tags (season, style, place, purpose) for a more precise search. Present the results in the order they appear in the array. Reordering them makes the user pick a different product when they refer to one by position, such as the second one.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

sites.name: angular.courses
sites.description: Ship Angular upgrades faster. Compatibility, release insights, and skimmable editions—one place. Avoid surprises and learn how Angular features evolved.

tools.name: caniuse_search_features
tools.description: Search Angular's Can I Use feature-compatibility catalog (APIs, CLI capabilities, and other Angular features). Returns each match's name, package, description and status per Angular major version. Use this to find the exact feature name/id before calling caniuse_get_feature.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against the feature name.

package.description: Exact npm package name to filter by, e.g. "@angular/core".

status.description: Only return features whose latest known status equals this value.

limit.description: Max results to return (default 20, max 100).

tools.name: caniuse_get_feature
tools.description: Get the full picture for one Angular feature: description, notes, version-by-version status history and links, plus everything needed to migrate off it. Cross-references the replacement feature (if deprecated/removed), the matching ng-update/ng-generate schematic, the matching Angular ESLint caniuse rule, and any matching manually-tracked migration - mixing four separate catalogs so an agent doesn't have to cross-reference tabs by hand.

name.description: Feature name or id, e.g. "Standalone API" or "standalone-api". Partial matches are allowed; if ambiguous, candidate names are returned instead of a guess.

tools.name: caniuse_get_upgrade_plan
tools.description: Build an upgrade briefing for moving an Angular app from one major version to another. Mixes five sources: Can I Use feature status changes (newly introduced/promoted/deprecated features), the ng-update migrations catalog (mandatory vs optional schematics), the Angular ESLint caniuse rules introduced in that range, the official Node/TypeScript/RxJS compatibility matrix for the target version, and the official release announcement (and video, when available) for each version crossed. Prefer this over separately calling caniuse_search_features, an eslint lookup and a migrations lookup when the user asks something like "what do I need to do to go from v18 to v22".

tools.name: caniuse_get_mcp_tools
tools.description: List the tools and resources exposed by Angular's own development MCP server (the server Angular CLI / IDEs use, e.g. get_best_practices, search_documentation, onpush-zoneless-migration), with their status per Angular version. Not to be confused with this page's own WebMCP tools, which are about the page itself.

version.description: Only compute status as of this Angular version (uses the closest earlier version entry).

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against the name or description.

tools.name: caniuse_list_eslint_rules
tools.description: List the Angular ESLint caniuse rules tracked on this page, optionally limited to those available by a given Angular version. Each rule links a lint rule to the Angular feature/version it enforces or helps migrate.

version.description: Only include rules introduced at or before this Angular version.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against the name or description.

tools.name: caniuse_set_view
tools.description: Drive this Can I Use page's own UI: switch tab (features, diff, migrations, update, mcp, eslint), set the global search box, and/or set the package/status filters on the Features tab. Use this so the person watching the browser sees the results you found, instead of only reporting them in chat. Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

tools.name: caniuse_open_feature
tools.description: Open the detail panel for one Can I Use feature in the browser: switches to the Features tab, filters the list to it, and opens its detail sheet. Use after caniuse_search_features or caniuse_get_feature to visually surface a result for the person watching.

tools.name: caniuse_current_view
tools.description: The Can I Use page's current UI state: active tab, search text, package/status filters, and how many results are currently showing in each tab. Read this before caniuse_set_view to avoid redundant changes.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes the quantity of items already in the cart, or removes an item. Specify only the items you want to change; the rest stay as they are. A quantity of 0 removes that item. Identify items by the item.id from a get_cart result.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. Without them the other items in the cart are ordered too. Domestic and international shipping items cannot be checked out together; if the cart has both, ask the user which group to check out and pass that group's item_ids. To buy one product immediately without using the cart, use create-checkout-url. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

sites.description: Online store with product search, cart management and checkout tools.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Searches products in this store. In addition to a product name you can pass situational tags (season, style, place, purpose) for a more precise search. Present the results in the order they appear in the array. Reordering them makes the user pick a different product when they refer to one by position, such as the second one.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

sites.name: appinformatica.com
sites.description: APP Informática is a Spanish chain of computer stores and franchises selling hardware and electronics online.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Busca productos en el catálogo de la tienda por texto libre. Devuelve nombre, precio, disponibilidad, SKU y URL de cada resultado. NO navega ni añade nada al carrito: usa navigate_to para llevar al usuario a los resultados y add_to_cart para comprar.

query.description: Texto a buscar, ej. "iphone 15", "portátil gaming", "cartucho HP 302"

limit.description: Número máximo de resultados (1-50). Por defecto 10.

id.description: SKU del producto — úsalo en add_to_cart

url.description: Ruta interna de la ficha — úsala en navigate_to

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Obtiene el detalle completo de un producto a partir de su ID o SKU (el campo «id» que devuelve search_products). Úsalo antes de add_to_cart para confirmar precio y stock.

product_id.description: ID o SKU del producto en VTEX

id.description: SKU del producto — úsalo en add_to_cart

url.description: Ruta interna de la ficha — úsala en navigate_to

tools.name: browse_categories
tools.description: Devuelve el árbol de categorías de la tienda con sus URLs. Úsalo cuando el usuario quiera explorar el catálogo por secciones en lugar de buscar un producto concreto.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Devuelve el contenido actual del carrito: líneas con nombre, SKU, cantidad, precio unitario y totales. Funciona desde cualquier página.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Añade un producto al carrito por su SKU. Obtén el SKU con search_products o get_product; nunca lo inventes. La cantidad es incremental: llamar dos veces con quantity=1 deja 2 unidades.

quantity.description: Unidades a añadir. Por defecto 1.

seller.description: ID del vendedor en VTEX. Por defecto "1".

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Cambia la cantidad de una línea del carrito o la elimina. La cantidad es absoluta, no un incremento: quantity=0 elimina la línea. Identifica la línea con el SKU que devuelve get_cart.

sku_id.description: SKU de la línea a modificar

quantity.description: Cantidad final. 0 elimina la línea.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Lleva el navegador del usuario a una página de la tienda: resultados de búsqueda, ficha de producto, categoría o carrito. Usa las rutas que devuelven las demás tools; no construyas URLs a mano. Tras esta llamada el usuario YA está en la página: no le pidas que haga clic en ningún enlace ni vuelvas a navegar.

path.description: Ruta interna que empieza por "/", ej. "/search?q=iphone", "/product/mi-producto", "/cart"

tools.name: go_to_checkout
tools.description: Lleva al usuario al checkout para finalizar la compra. Requiere el carrito con al menos un artículo. Tras esta llamada el usuario ya está en el checkout: no navegues de nuevo.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes the quantity of items already in the cart, or removes an item. Specify only the items you want to change; the rest stay as they are. A quantity of 0 removes that item. Identify items by the item.id from a get_cart result.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. Without them the other items in the cart are ordered too. Domestic and international shipping items cannot be checked out together; if the cart has both, ask the user which group to check out and pass that group's item_ids. To buy one product immediately without using the cart, use create-checkout-url. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes the quantity of items already in the cart, or removes an item. Specify only the items you want to change; the rest stay as they are. A quantity of 0 removes that item. Identify items by the item.id from a get_cart result.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. Without them the other items in the cart are ordered too. Domestic and international shipping items cannot be checked out together; if the cart has both, ask the user which group to check out and pass that group's item_ids. item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

sites.description: Online retailer of coffee and tea.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Searches products in this store. In addition to a product name you can pass situational tags (season, style, place, purpose) for a more precise search. navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. Without them the other items in the cart are ordered too. Domestic and international shipping items cannot be checked out together; if the cart has both, ask the user which group to check out and pass that group's item_ids. To buy one product immediately without using the cart, use create-checkout-url. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

sites.name: athomecorpservice.com
sites.description: Online store with product search, cart management and checkout tools.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Searches products in this store. In addition to a product name you can pass situational tags (season, style, place, purpose) for a more precise search. Present the results in the order they appear in the array. Reordering them makes the user pick a different product when they refer to one by position, such as the second one.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes the quantity of items already in the cart, or removes an item. Specify only the items you want to change; the rest stay as they are. A quantity of 0 removes that item. Identify items by the item.id from a get_cart result.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

sites.name: autohled.cz
sites.description: Car comparisons, specifications, and reviews

tools.name: autohled_compare_cars
tools.description: Put two to four cars side by side (price, size, boot, power, consumption, range, rating). Prefer this over several autohled_model_detail calls when the user is comparing. Answer in the language of the page (see source.locale).

cars.description: Tokens "make/model" (e.g. "skoda/octavia") or "make/model/engineSlug" for a variant-level comparison.

tools.name: autohled_current_page
tools.description: Identifies what the visitor is looking at (home, make, model, engine, comparator, catalog, review, article) and, for model and engine pages, returns that car's profile so you can answer questions about "this car" without asking which one. Answer in the language of the page (see source.locale).

tools.name: autohled_engine_detail
tools.description: Detailed specification and price of one engine variant of a model. Pass the engineSlug returned by autohled_model_detail. Answer in the language of the page (see source.locale).

tools.name: autohled_lineup
tools.description: The whole current model range of the make, with length and price deltas relative to the given model ("is there a bigger/cheaper one from the same brand?"). Answer in the language of the page (see source.locale).

tools.name: autohled_model_detail
tools.description: Full profile of one current model: Czech price from the official price list (with date and source), dimensions, boot, towing, editorial rating with pros/cons, and the engine/variant list with per-variant prices and slugs. Use make/model slugs from autohled_search_cars. Answer in the language of the page (see source.locale).

engines.description: How many engine variants to include, default 8.

tools.name: autohled_open_page
tools.description: Navigate the visitor's browser to a page on autohled.cz: a model page, an engine variant, a comparison of 2-4 cars, or the catalog. Nothing is submitted or purchased; it only changes the page shown.

page.description: Which page type to open. "enquiry" opens Autohled's free new-car offer request form for the model.

tools.name: autohled_rivals
tools.description: Competing models Autohled lists against a given model (same class, similar price), with price and key specs. Answer in the language of the page (see source.locale).

tools.name: autohled_search_cars
tools.description: Search the Autohled catalog of new cars sold in the Czech Republic by make, body, fuel, drive, price (CZK), power, seats, boot, towing, EV range or length. Returns models with the cheapest variant price, spec ranges and a link. Use this first to find the right make/model slugs. Answer in the language of the page (see source.locale).

make.description: Make name or slug, e.g. "Škoda" or "skoda". Optional.

body.description: Body styles to include.

price_min.description: Minimum price in CZK.

price_max.description: Maximum price in CZK.

towing_min.description: Minimum braked towing capacity in kg.

range_min.description: Minimum WLTP electric range in km (EVs).

sites.name: automokorea.com
sites.description: Online retailer of electrical and electronic equipment.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Searches products in this store. In addition to a product name you can pass situational tags (season, style, place, purpose) for a more precise search. Present the results in the order they appear in the array. Reordering them makes the user pick a different product when they refer to one by position, such as the second one.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes the quantity of items already in the cart, or removes an item. Specify only the items you want to change; the rest stay as they are. A quantity of 0 removes that item. Identify items by the item.id from a get_cart result.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. Without them the other items in the cart are ordered too. Domestic and international shipping items cannot be checked out together; if the cart has both, ask the user which group to check out and pass that group's item_ids. To buy one product immediately without using the cart, use create-checkout-url. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes the quantity of items already in the cart, or removes an item. Specify only the items you want to change; the rest stay as they are. A quantity of 0 removes that item. Identify items by the item.id from a get_cart result.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url

To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url

item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. Without them the other items in the cart are ordered too. Domestic and international shipping items cannot be checked out together; if the cart has both, ask the user which group to check out and pass that group's item_ids. To buy one product immediately without using the cart, use create-checkout-url. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

sites.name: babyandme.kr
sites.description: Online retailer of baby and children's products.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Searches products in this store. In addition to a product name you can pass situational tags (season, style, place, purpose) for a more precise search. Present the results in the order they appear in the array. Reordering them makes the user pick a different product when they refer to one by position, such as the second one.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code
