sites.name: dabdabdab.com
sites.description: Try lipstick, eyeshadow, blush, foundation, eyeliner, and mascara in a virtual makeup studio. Explore on a demo model or use your camera and AI makeup artist.

tools.name: get_makeup_state
tools.description: Reads mirror readiness and source, undo availability, selected controls, available styles, applied layers, and saved product sets. Call this before applying or refining makeup. This tool has no side effects. Private mirror: never screenshot, record, or read camera/video/canvas pixels, even on errors. Verify with tool results or get_makeup_state; ask the user to judge appearance. On failure, retry or ask the user.

tools.name: apply_makeup
tools.description: Applies or updates one makeup layer and synchronizes the visible controls. Use apply_full_makeup_look instead when creating or replacing a multi-layer look. Private mirror: never screenshot, record, or read camera/video/canvas pixels, even on errors. Verify with tool results or get_makeup_state; ask the user to judge appearance. On failure, retry or ask the user.

intensity.description: Cosmetic intensity: subtle (default), enhanced, defined, or dramatic.

category.description: The facial feature to apply or update.

color.description: An opaque six-digit hex shade such as #A04F5F.

finish.description: Optional finish for lipstick, eyeshadow, blush, or foundation.

style.description: Optional application style. Use a value listed for this category in get_makeup_state.availableStyles.

rationale.description: Optional short reason this layer suits the requested look.

tools.name: apply_full_makeup_look
tools.description: Replaces the current makeup with a complete set of one to six uniquely categorized layers. The site validates every layer before changing the mirror and records the complete look as one undoable action. Private mirror: never screenshot, record, or read camera/video/canvas pixels, even on errors. Verify with tool results or get_makeup_state; ask the user to judge appearance. On failure, retry or ask the user.

lookName.description: Optional concise name for the complete look, such as Soft Rose Day Look.

layers.description: The complete set of makeup layers that should remain visible.

intensity.description: Cosmetic intensity: subtle (default), enhanced, defined, or dramatic.

category.description: The facial feature to apply or update.

color.description: An opaque six-digit hex shade such as #A04F5F.

finish.description: Optional finish for lipstick, eyeshadow, blush, or foundation.

style.description: Optional application style. Use a value listed for this category in get_makeup_state.availableStyles.

rationale.description: Optional short reason the complete look is suitable.

tools.name: analyze_coloring
tools.description: Creates an editable skin, eye, and hair color profile. Use subject user only after See it on me and a request for personalized analysis; demo_model is for the demo. On-device analysis shares color estimates only, never images or landmarks. Camera permission does not authorize agent image access. Private mirror: never screenshot, record, or read camera/video/canvas pixels, even on errors. Verify with tool results or get_makeup_state; ask the user to judge appearance. On failure, retry or ask the user.

subject.description: Who should be analyzed. This must match the active mirror source.

tools.name: get_appearance_profile
tools.description: Reads the editable color profile. Prefer user-confirmed values; treat low-confidence estimates as approximate. No side effects. On-device analysis shares color estimates only, never images or landmarks. Camera permission does not authorize agent image access. Private mirror: never screenshot, record, or read camera/video/canvas pixels, even on errors. Verify with tool results or get_makeup_state; ask the user to judge appearance. On failure, retry or ask the user.

tools.name: undo_last_makeup_change
tools.description: Restores the makeup state from before the latest human or agent makeup change and synchronizes the visible controls. Returns an unchanged result when no undo history is available. Private mirror: never screenshot, record, or read camera/video/canvas pixels, even on errors. Verify with tool results or get_makeup_state; ask the user to judge appearance. On failure, retry or ask the user.

tools.name: clear_makeup
tools.description: Clears one makeup layer or the complete look and synchronizes the visible controls. The change can be reversed with undo_last_makeup_change. Private mirror: never screenshot, record, or read camera/video/canvas pixels, even on errors. Verify with tool results or get_makeup_state; ask the user to judge appearance. On failure, retry or ask the user.

category.description: The layer to clear, or all for the complete look.

tools.name: show_product_matches
tools.description: Shows up to six real Amazon.com products for a named look, even after makeup changes. Search Amazon first; never invent details or URLs. Earlier sets remain available this session. Private mirror: never screenshot, record, or read camera/video/canvas pixels, even on errors. Verify with tool results or get_makeup_state; ask the user to judge appearance. On failure, retry or ask the user.

lookName.description: A concise name for the complete look, such as Night Out Look.

products.description: Amazon product candidates grounded in search results.

category.description: The makeup category this product recommendation matches.

title.description: The product title shown in the search result.

amazonUrl.description: A direct HTTPS Amazon.com product page containing a real ASIN.

imageUrl.description: Optional direct product image from an approved Amazon media host.

matchReason.description: A concise explanation of how the product matches the requested look.

Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes the quantity of items already in the cart, or removes an item. Specify only the items you want to change; the rest stay as they are. A quantity of 0 removes that item. Identify items by the item.id from a get_cart result.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. Without them the other items in the cart are ordered too. Domestic and international shipping items cannot be checked out together; if the cart has both, ask the user which group to check out and pass that group's item_ids. To buy one product immediately without using the cart, use create-checkout-url. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

sites.name: dailyyam.com
sites.description: Online store with product search, cart management and checkout tools.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Searches products in this store. In addition to a product name you can pass situational tags (season, style, place, purpose) for a more precise search. Present the results in the order they appear in the array. Reordering them makes the user pick a different product when they refer to one by position, such as the second one.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

sites.name: dayroze.com
sites.description: Online store with product search, cart management and checkout tools.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Searches products in this store. In addition to a product name you can pass situational tags (season, style, place, purpose) for a more precise search. Present the results in the order they appear in the array. Reordering them makes the user pick a different product when they refer to one by position, such as the second one.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

sites.name: deara.co.kr
sites.description: Online retailer of cosmetics and skincare.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Searches products in this store. In addition to a product name you can pass situational tags (season, style, place, purpose) for a more precise search. Present the results in the order they appear in the array. Reordering them makes the user pick a different product when they refer to one by position, such as the second one.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. Without them the other items in the cart are ordered too. Domestic and international shipping items cannot be checked out together; if the cart has both, ask the user which group to check out and pass that group's item_ids. To buy one product immediately without using the cart, use create-checkout-url. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

sites.name: demo.spreadfront.com
sites.description: A live example store, generated entirely from a Google Sheet. Browse, add to cart, try the checkout - orders here are not fulfilled.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search this store's product catalog. Returns matching products with id, price, availability and buyable options (variants). Use the returned id with add_to_cart.

query.description: Free-text search over name, description, brand and category. Omit to browse by filters alone.

category.description: Exact category filter (case-insensitive).

brand.description: Exact brand filter (case-insensitive).

min_price.description: Only products priced at or above this (store currency).

max_price.description: Only products priced at or below this (store currency).

in_stock.description: true = only products that can be ordered right now.

interval.description: week/month/year for subscription products; absent otherwise.

options.description: Buyer-selectable variant groups; every group needs a choice at add_to_cart.

output_schema.description: On failure the result instead carries { error: string } with isError true.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full details for one product by its id (from search_products), including price, availability, description, images and buyable options (variants).

interval.description: week/month/year for subscription products; absent otherwise.

options.description: Buyer-selectable variant groups; every group needs a choice at add_to_cart.

output_schema.description: On failure the result instead carries { error: string } with isError true.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Get the current shopping cart: line items, quantities, selected options, subtotal and the checkout URL.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the cart. For products with options (variants), pass every option as {"OptionName": "Value"} - get_product lists the allowed values. Same product with identical options increments quantity.

quantity.description: How many to add (default 1, max 999).

options.description: Variant choices, e.g. {"Size": "M", "Color": "Red"}. Required when the product has options.

output_schema.description: On failure the result instead carries { error: string } with isError true.

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Set the quantity of a cart line (0 removes it). Identify the line by product id and, when the product has options, the same options used to add it.

id.description: Product id of the cart line.

quantity.description: New quantity; 0 removes the line.

options.description: The variant choices of the line to change, if it has any.

output_schema.description: On failure the result instead carries { error: string } with isError true.

tools.name: fill_checkout_form
tools.description: Fill the checkout form on the cart page with details collected from the user, so the human only reviews and submits. Maps conversation data to the right fields: full_name is ONE field (combine first and last name), address is a single free-text delivery address. Never submits - the human completes any security check and presses the order button. Only works on the cart/checkout page (call proceed_to_checkout first; after the page loads, call this).

full_name.description: Buyer full name as one string, e.g. "Jane Smith" (combine first and last name).

email.description: Buyer email address - order confirmations go here.

phone.description: Phone number, if the user provided one.

address.description: Full delivery address as one free-text block (street, city, postal code, country as applicable).

note.description: Optional note to the seller.

custom.description: Values for the store extra checkout fields, keyed by the field label exactly as shown, e.g. {"Gift message": "Happy birthday"}.

payment_method.description: One of the payment options visible on the page: "card", "paypal", "crypto", "cod" (cash on delivery / pickup) or "link" (pay online).

missingRequiredFields.description: Required inputs still empty - collect these from the user and call again.

output_schema.description: On failure the result instead carries { error: string } with isError true.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Get information about this store: name, description, currency, product count and the checkout URL.

output_schema.description: On failure the result instead carries { error: string } with isError true.

tools.name: proceed_to_checkout
tools.description: Navigate the shopper’s current browser session to the checkout page. This action does NOT place an order or submit payment - the human shopper must review the cart and complete checkout manually. Call after the cart is ready.

sites.name: demor.co.kr
sites.description: Online retailer of furniture and home furnishings.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Searches products in this store. In addition to a product name you can pass situational tags (season, style, place, purpose) for a more precise search. Present the results in the order they appear in the array. Reordering them makes the user pick a different product when they refer to one by position, such as the second one.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes the quantity of items already in the cart, or removes an item. Specify only the items you want to change; the rest stay as they are. A quantity of 0 removes that item. Identify items by the item.id from a get_cart result.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: create_cart

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. Without them the other items in the cart are ordered too. Domestic and international shipping items cannot be checked out together; if the cart has both, ask the user which group to check out and pass that group's item_ids. To buy one product immediately without using the cart, use create-checkout-url. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

sites.name: dg-herb.com
sites.description: Online store with product search, cart management and checkout tools.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Searches products in this store. In addition to a product name you can pass situational tags (season, style, place, purpose) for a more precise search. Present the results in the order they appear in the array. Reordering them makes the user pick a different product when they refer to one by position, such as the second one.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes the quantity of items already in the cart, or removes an item. Specify only the items you want to change; the rest stay as they are. A quantity of 0 removes that item. Identify items by the item.id from a get_cart result.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes the quantity of items already in the cart, or removes an item. Specify only the items you want to change; the rest stay as they are. A quantity of 0 removes that item. Identify items by the item.id from a get_cart result.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. Without them the other items in the cart are ordered too. Domestic and international shipping items cannot be checked out together; if the cart has both, ask the user which group to check out and pass that group's item_ids. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes the quantity of items already in the cart, or removes an item. Specify only the items you want to change; the rest stay as they are. A quantity of 0 removes that item. Identify items by the item.id from a get_cart result.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. Without them the other items in the cart are ordered too. Domestic and international shipping items cannot be checked out together; if the cart has both, ask the user which group to check out and pass that group's item_ids. To buy one product immediately without using the cart, use create-checkout-url. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

sites.name: directos.eu
sites.description: Online delicatessen selling Spanish and French cured meats from producers, such as saucisson, chorizo, fuet, jamón and sobrasada, plus gift boxes and hampers.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Directos delicatessen catalog (Spanish and French charcuterie: saucisson, chorizo, fuet, jamon, sobrasada). Returns a short projection of each matching product with its price, weight and canonical URL. Product names are in the language of the current page, so translate the query accordingly before calling. Use get_product_details for allergens, nutrition facts and meat origin.

query.description: Free text matched against product name, benefits and categories. Omit to list the catalog.

benefit.description: Filter on a product benefit, as returned in the benefits field of a previous search.

minPrice.description: Minimum price per unit, tax included, in EUR.

maxPrice.description: Maximum price per unit, tax included, in EUR.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, max 50).

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get full details for one product: price tiers, weight, packaging constraints, allergens, nutrition facts per 100g and meat origin. Identify the product by productId (from search_products) or by slug. Long marketing copy is not included: follow the returned url for it.

slug.description: Product slug as it appears in the page URL.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read the current shopping cart: line items with quantities and unit prices, subtotal, total weight. Does not include shipping cost, use estimate_shipping_cost for that.

tools.name: estimate_shipping_cost
tools.description: Estimate delivery options and their cost for a destination, based on the current cart. Only a country code and a postal code are needed, never a full address. Each option reports thresholdForFree, the cart amount that unlocks free delivery (null when the option never offers it), and isFreeForCurrentCart for the cart as it stands. When free delivery is not reached yet, missingForFree tells how much is left to add.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. FR, BE, ES.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the shopping cart. The cart is only prepared, never ordered or paid: the customer stays in control of checkout. The requested quantity is adjusted to the product packaging rules, and the applied quantity is returned. Products sold in several formats are refused with the list of their variations, call again with the chosen productId.

slug.description: Product slug as it appears in the page URL.

quantity.description: Desired quantity. Adjusted to packaging constraints. Defaults to the minimum sellable quantity.

tools.name: set_cart_item_quantity
tools.description: Set the quantity of a product already in the cart. Use 0 to remove it. The quantity is adjusted to the packaging rules of the product.

productId.description: Product identifier, as returned by get_cart.

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the line.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove a product from the shopping cart entirely.

productId.description: Product identifier, as returned by get_cart.

tools.name: go_to_checkout
tools.description: Open the cart summary page so the customer can review the order and complete the checkout themselves. This does not place an order and does not pay.

sites.description: Online store with product search, cart management and checkout tools.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Searches products in this store. In addition to a product name you can pass situational tags (season, style, place, purpose) for a more precise search. Present the results in the order they appear in the array. Reordering them makes the user pick a different product when they refer to one by position, such as the second one.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. The result is reflected in the store cart page as-is. Some products can be shipped either domestically or internationally, and domestic and international items go into separate carts. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after adding. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes the quantity of items already in the cart, or removes an item. Specify only the items you want to change; the rest stay as they are. A quantity of 0 removes that item. Identify items by the item.id from a get_cart result.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after updating. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

items.description: Items whose quantity should change. Items you do not list stay as they are.

item_id.description: item.id from a get_cart result, for example cafe24_mall_1_22_P000000W000A

quantity.description: New quantity. 0 removes the item from the cart.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Empties the whole cart. This cannot be undone, so the tool does not run it immediately; it shows a confirmation button on screen and the user has to press it.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page after emptying. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

tools.name: create-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for buying one product immediately. This bypasses the cart and cannot order multiple products at once. To order everything in the cart, use create-cart-checkout-url instead. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

product_no.description: Product number. Omit it to use the product on the page the user is currently viewing. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

variant_code.description: Variant code. Omit it to use the variant the user has selected on the current product page.

quantity.description: Quantity to buy. Omit it to use the quantity field on the current page, falling back to 1.

tools.name: create-cart-checkout-url
tools.description: Creates a checkout page for the items in the cart. Without item_ids it orders the entire cart. When the user wants only part of it, such as just what I added, only this one, or only the jeans, you must call get_cart first and pass those item.id values in item_ids. Without them the other items in the cart are ordered too. Domestic and international shipping items cannot be checked out together; if the cart has both, ask the user which group to check out and pass that group's item_ids. To buy one product immediately without using the cart, use create-checkout-url. This tool always moves the browser to the checkout page it creates. Navigation is not optional, so do not tell the user to click a link.

item_ids.description: Restricts the order to these items. Pass item.id values from a get_cart result. Omit it to order the entire cart.

sites.name: docsmedi.co.kr
sites.description: Online retailer of health supplements.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Searches products in this store. In addition to a product name you can pass situational tags (season, style, place, purpose) for a more precise search. Present the results in the order they appear in the array. Reordering them makes the user pick a different product when they refer to one by position, such as the second one.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the search results page. If exactly one product matches, it moves to that product page instead. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_name.description: Product name to search for, for example 't-shirt' or 'sneakers'. Separate multiple names with commas. Map the central product type of the user request to this field.

product_tag.description: Situational tags such as season, occasion or purpose, extracted from the user request. For example: summer, commute, hiking, home workout. Separate multiple tags with commas.

price_min.description: Minimum price. Map expressions such as 'over 10,000 won', 'at least $10' or 'from $20'. Pass digits only; currency handling is done by the store.

price_max.description: Maximum price. Map expressions such as 'under 50,000 won', 'under $50' or 'at most 30,000 won'. Pass digits only.

sort.description: Sort key for the results. Map it when the user asks for newest first, by name, or recently updated.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc. Map it when the user asks for ascending order, lowest price first, or most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Map it when the user names a count such as 'just 10' or 'top 5'. Omit to use the default.

tools.name: search-products-detail
tools.description: Retrieves the detail of one product by product number. When the user refers to a product by position, such as the second one, use the product_no at that index of the previous search-products result. The array order is the reference, not any order you presented.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to that product page. When the request identifies a single product, set true whether the user says tell me or show me, because the user is about to look at it. Omit it only while looking up several products in a row to compare them. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

product_no.description: Product number

variants_verbose.description: Set to true to expand variant detail. Each variant then carries additional_amount and option_axes, up to 100 variants are returned, and the response includes variants_total and variants_truncated. Defaults to false, which returns at most 5 variants.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieves the items and amounts in the user cart. Called with no arguments it reads the cart shown on the store cart page. Use it for requests such as what is in my cart or what is the total.

navigate.description: Set to true to move the browser to the cart page. Only set true when the user asks to be taken somewhere (show me / open it / go there). Omit it when the user is only asking a question. Defaults to false; when true the page actually changes.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier to read. Omit it to read the cart on the screen the user is viewing; normally omit it.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Adds a product to the cart. With no arguments it adds the variant and quantity the user has selected on the product page they are viewing. For those products you must ask the user which one they want and pass delivery_type; never choose it yourself.

delivery_type.description: Shipping the user chose for products that offer both domestic and international shipping. Ask the user before setting it. It is ignored for products that ship only one way.

cart.description: Items to add. Omit it to use the selection on the current product page. It cannot be omitted on pages other than a product detail page.

quantity.description: Quantity to add

context.description: Context such as shipping country, region and postal code

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to list.

price.description: Asking price as a whole number in the chosen currency, e.g. 1250.

currency.description: ISO currency. Defaults to EUR.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually create the public listing.
